title: Extension of Referrals and Authorizations: Who May Ask and the Request Deadline
content:
Where the authorization type allows extensions, the requesting or servicing provider may ask to extend an approved authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations**.

## 1. Deadline

An extension request must be received no later than the type's acceptance figure, in calendar days, after the authorization's last span day. The deadline is counted in calendar days starting the day after the last span day, so with zero days the request must arrive on or before the last span day itself and a request on the next day is late. The last span day is read from the authorization's system record.

## 2. Late or over-limit requests

A late request, or one beyond the extension limits, is a new request under the type's basis for authorizing care beyond the authorization.

## 3. Extensions granted

The extensions granted on an authorization are the count of its extension entries over its life.

## 4. Earlier extension clause (no longer in force)

> Each extension adds the type's extension units and moves the last span day out by the type's extension validity days, up to the type's most extensions (counted as the extensions granted) and never beyond the type's most units per authorization in total.

This clause, with the unit arithmetic that followed from it, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

With an acceptance figure of 0 days and a last span day of 30 June:

| Request received | On time |
|---|---|
| 29 June | yes |
| 30 June | yes; the boundary day itself is on time |
| 1 July | no; it is a new request under the type's basis for care beyond the authorization |

superseded_clauses: each extension adds extension_units and moves valid_through out by extension_validity_days, up to max_extensions extensions (referral_msr_extensions_granted) and never beyond max_units_per_authorization in total.
